verification_status.verification_notes: The scholarship nomination deadline (15 Aug 2026) has passed; the MSc itself accepts applications until 31 Oct 2026 per search results (apply page not read directly), but late applicants are not considered for this scholarship. Number of awards and exact amounts not stated. Entry requirements (Honours in maths, applied maths, CS or statistics, or a 4-year electrical engineering degree; Python) come from search results of the apply page and were not verified directly. The 2022 tweet lead said 'file only if funding exists': funding exists.
